data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic word 'lahj' meaning delight or pleasure. In Islamic tradition, it symbolizes the joy and contentment that comes from living a virtuous life and pleasing Allah. The name Lahjah carries the meaning “Delight, pleasure” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Lahjah usually hope their child will grow to embody delight, pleasure and live with faith, good character and purpose.
